name: elagoht/websocket
description: A collage plugin that carries collage-live's pushed fragments over a WebSocket instead of an event stream.

config.description: A collage plugin that carries collage-live's pushed fragments over a WebSocket instead of an event stream.

originPatterns.description: OriginPatterns are the hosts, besides the site's own, whose pages may connect — as github.com/coder/websocket matches them. A connection carries the reader's cookies, so a page on another origin must not be able to open one on the reader's behalf; the default allows only the site itself.
